questions.q: Irene went to office 'every single day by walk'.
questions.s: Explanation:- 'On foot' sahi idiom hai paidal chalne ke liye. Hum 'by car' ya 'by bus' bolte hain lekin 'by walk' galat English hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: Drinking tea is a English 'habit'.
questions.s: Simple sa rule hai. 'Habit' ek individual insaan ki hoti hai, lekin jab puri society ya desh (English people) ki baat ho, toh wo 'Custom' (rivaaz) ban jata hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: He has bought 'four dozens mangoes'.
questions.s: Dhyaan se dekho! Jab Dozen se pehle number (four) ho, toh 'Dozen' singular rehta hai. 'Four dozen mangoes' sahi hai.

questions.q: The 'publics' are not satisfied with the new act.
questions.s: Sahi hoga 'The public is'. 'Public' ek collective noun hai jo singular treat kiya jata hai. 'Publics' koi word nahi hota.

questions.q: My 'visiting' to my family are few and far between.
questions.s: Yahan 'My visits' aayega. 'Are' plural verb hai, isliye subject bhi plural noun (Visits) hona chahiye.

questions.q: Since you are unable / to repay the loan you have no 'alternate' / but to seek / an extension.
o: to repay the loan you have no alternate
questions.s: Word confusion! 'Alternate' ka matlab 'ek chhodkar ek' hota hai. 'Alternative' ka matlab 'dusra raasta/vikalp' hota hai. Yahan 'Alternative' aayega.

questions.q: It will take at least / one and a half 'year' / to complete this project.
questions.s: Rule yaad kar lo: 'One and a half' ke baad aane wala noun hamesha plural hota hai. 'One and a half years' sahi hai.

questions.q: 'Major hubs of' the information technology industry is the Silicon Valley of Central California.
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement! Verb 'is' singular hai, isliye Subject bhi Singular 'A major hub' hona chahiye.

questions.q: 'Tons of sheep' was grazing in the field.
questions.s: Sheep ke group ko 'Flock' kehte hain. Aur haan, 'Sheeps' koi word nahi hota, plural bhi 'Sheep' hi rehta hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: The poetries / of R.N. Tagore / has been taught / in the class.
questions.s: Yahan par bohot bacche mistake karte hain. 'Poetry' uncountable hai, iska plural 'Poetries' nahi hota. 'Poems' ya 'Poetry' use karein.

questions.q: Her 'hairs' are curly / and beautiful / No Error.
questions.s: Uncountable Noun! Jab hum sir ke baalon ki baat karte hain toh 'Hair' singular rehta hai. 'Her hair is curly' sahi hoga.

questions.q: He did many 'mischiefs' / in the class / yesterday.
questions.s: 'Mischief' (sharat) uncountable noun hai. Iska plural nahi banta. 'Many acts of mischief' ya 'Much mischief' bolo.

questions.q: We saw / many deers / in the zoo / No Error.
questions.s: Exam mein examiner yahan confuse karta hai. 'Deer', 'Sheep', 'Fish' ka singular aur plural same rehta hai. 'Deers' galat hai.

questions.q: The cavalry / was ordered / to march forward / No Error.
questions.s: 'Cavalry' (ghudsawar sena) plural collective noun hai. Iske saath verb 'Were' aayegi, 'Was' nahi.

questions.q: The 'wages' of sin / are death / according to the Bible.
questions.s: Important concept! Jab 'Wages' ka matlab 'saza/phal' (punishment/result) ho, toh wo singular hota hai. 'The wages of sin is death'.

questions.q: The prisoner / was put / in irons / No Error.
questions.s: No Error. 'Iron' matlab loha, par 'Irons' ka matlab 'bediyan' (shackles) hota hai. Context sahi hai.

questions.q: She gives / herself / airs / No Error.
questions.s: No Error. 'Air' matlab hawa, 'Airs' matlab 'ghamand' (proud behaviour). Yahan meaning fit hai.

questions.q: My assistant will see you 'in the meets' next week.
questions.s: Sahi phrase 'at the meeting' hai. Official appointment ke liye hum 'meeting' (singular) word use karte hain.

questions.q: 'No other informations' was conveyed to him.
questions.s: Yahan 'No other information' aayega. 'Information' uncountable noun hai, iska plural nahi banta.

questions.q: For 'your and your wife sake', find a job.
questions.s: Correct phrase 'for your wife's sake' hai. 'Sake' ke saath possessive case aana zaroori hai.

questions.q: Radha bought a sheet of paper from the 'stationary'...
o: Radha bought a sheet of paper
questions.s: Spelling error! 'Stationary' = sthir. Pen-paper wali dukaan = 'Stationery' ('e' ke saath).

questions.q: An ellipse has two 'focus' and a circle has only one centre.
questions.s: Singular-Plural ka khel hai. 'Focus' singular hai. Iska plural 'Foci' hota hai. 'Two Foci' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Please tell him that my father has sent him 'regard'.
questions.s: Replace REGARD with REGARDS. Shubhkamnayein dene ke liye hamesha plural 'Regards' use karte hain.

questions.q: Many 'summons' have been issued to Rahul Gandhi so far.
questions.s: Dhyaan se dekho! 'Many' ke baad Plural noun chahiye. 'Summons' singular hai, iska plural 'Summonses' hota hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: There is no 'place' in the compartment.
questions.s: Exam mein examiner yahan confuse karta hai. Closed space (jaise car, train) mein jagah ke liye 'Room' use karte hain, 'Place' nahi. 'No Room' sahi hai.
